name: std::fgetws
intro: Reads at most count - 1 wide characters from the given file stream and stores them in str. The produced wide string is always null-terminated. Parsing stops if end-of-file occurs or a newline wide character is found, in which case str will contain that wide newline character.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
str

 -

 wide string to read the characters to


 count

 -

 the length of str


 stream

 -

 file stream to read the data from

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: str on success, a null pointer on an error.
